properties.name: Tarbela Dam
properties.info: Indus River, KP. Earth-fill dam, about 143 m high, completed 1976. Largest earth-filled dam in the world.

properties.name: Mangla Dam
properties.info: Jhelum River, AJK. About 147 m high, completed 1967. Major dam for power and irrigation.

properties.name: Warsak Dam
properties.info: Kabul River, near Peshawar. Completed 1960 (Colombo Plan).

properties.name: Diamer-Bhasha Dam
properties.info: Indus River, Gilgit-Baltistan. Under construction; planned height about 272 m (RCC).

properties.name: Khanpur Dam
properties.info: Haro River, KP. Supplies water to Islamabad and Rawalpindi.

properties.name: Rawal Dam
properties.info: Rawal Lake, Islamabad. Built in 1962 on the Korang River.

properties.name: Hub Dam
properties.info: Hub River, Balochistan-Sindh border. Supplies water to Karachi.

properties.name: Satpara Dam
properties.info: Near Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan. Completed 2013; supplies Skardu.

properties.name: Saif-ul-Malook
properties.info: Kaghan Valley, KP. About 3,224 m above sea level.

properties.name: Manchar Lake
properties.info: Sindh. One of the largest freshwater lakes in Pakistan.

properties.name: Keenjhar Lake
properties.info: Thatta, Sindh. Main freshwater source for Karachi.

properties.name: Hanna Lake
properties.info: Near Quetta, Balochistan. Popular picnic spot.

properties.name: Attabad Lake
properties.info: Hunza, Gilgit-Baltistan. Formed by a landslide in January 2010.

properties.name: Lower Kachura (Shangrila)
properties.info: Near Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan. Famous tourist lake.

properties.name: Haleji Lake
properties.info: Thatta, Sindh. Wetland known for migratory birds.

properties.name: Sheosar Lake
properties.info: Deosai National Park, Gilgit-Baltistan. High-altitude lake at around 4,100 m.

properties.name: Khyber Pass
properties.info: Pak-Afghan border, KP. Historic route linking Peshawar and Jalalabad.

properties.name: Khunjerab Pass
properties.info: Pak-China border, Gilgit-Baltistan. About 4,693 m; among the highest paved border crossings in the world.

properties.name: Babusar Pass
properties.info: Connects Kaghan Valley and Gilgit-Baltistan. About 4,170 m.

properties.name: Bolan Pass
properties.info: Balochistan. Historic route between the Indus plains and Afghanistan.

properties.name: Lowari Pass
properties.info: Connects Dir and Chitral. About 3,100 m; Lowari Tunnel runs beneath it.

properties.name: Malakand Pass
properties.info: Connects the Peshawar valley with Swat and Dir, KP.

properties.name: Shandur Pass
properties.info: Between Chitral and Gilgit-Baltistan. About 3,700 m; famous for the Shandur polo festival.

properties.name: Kohat Pass
properties.info: Connects Peshawar and Kohat, KP. Kohat Tunnel opened in 2003.

properties.name: Mintaka Pass
properties.info: Pak-China border, Hunza. Historic Silk Road pass.

properties.name: Lahore Fort
properties.info: Lahore, Punjab. Mughal-era fort; UNESCO World Heritage Site (1981).

properties.name: Rohtas Fort
properties.info: Near Jhelum, Punjab. Built by Sher Shah Suri in the 1540s; UNESCO World Heritage Site (1997).

properties.name: Baltit Fort
properties.info: Karimabad, Hunza. Centuries-old fort restored as a museum.

properties.name: Derawar Fort
properties.info: Bahawalpur, Cholistan Desert, Punjab. Large square fortress with 40 bastions.

properties.name: Ranikot Fort
properties.info: Near Sann, Sindh. Often described as one of the largest forts in the world.

properties.name: Bala Hisar Fort
properties.info: Peshawar, KP. Ancient fort, now Frontier Corps headquarters.

properties.name: Attock Fort
properties.info: Attock, Punjab. Built by Akbar in 1581 on the Indus River.

properties.name: Kharpocho Fort
properties.info: Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan. Historic fort on a rock above the Indus.

properties.name: Kot Diji Fort
properties.info: Khairpur, Sindh. Built by the Talpur rulers in the late 1700s.

properties.name: Umerkot Fort
properties.info: Umerkot, Sindh. Birthplace of Mughal emperor Akbar (1542).

properties.name: Jinnah International (Karachi)
properties.info: IATA: KHI. Pakistan's busiest airport.

properties.name: Allama Iqbal International (Lahore)
properties.info: IATA: LHE. Main airport of Lahore, Punjab.

properties.name: Islamabad International
properties.info: IATA: ISB. Opened in 2018.

properties.name: Bacha Khan International (Peshawar)
properties.info: IATA: PEW. Main airport of KP.

properties.info: IATA: UET. Main airport of Balochistan.

properties.name: Multan International
properties.info: IATA: MUX.

properties.name: Faisalabad International
properties.info: IATA: LYP.

properties.name: Sialkot International
properties.info: IATA: SKT. Built privately and opened in 2007.

properties.name: Gilgit Airport
properties.info: IATA: GIL. Domestic airport of Gilgit-Baltistan.

properties.name: Skardu Airport
properties.info: IATA: KDU. Gateway to Baltistan and K2 treks.

properties.name: Chitral Airport
properties.info: IATA: CJL. Domestic airport of Chitral, KP.

properties.name: Karachi Port
properties.info: Pakistan's largest and oldest port, Sindh.

properties.name: Port Qasim
properties.info: Major port near Karachi, Sindh.

properties.name: Gwadar Port
properties.info: Deep-sea port in Balochistan; part of CPEC.

properties.name: Sust Dry Port
properties.info: Dry port on the Pak-China border route (Khunjerab), Gilgit-Baltistan.

properties.name: Lahore Dry Port
properties.info: Dry port at Mughalpura, Lahore, Punjab.

properties.info: 8,611 m. Second highest in the world and highest in Pakistan (Karakoram).

properties.name: Nanga Parbat
properties.info: 8,126 m. Ninth highest in the world; known as the Killer Mountain.

properties.name: Gasherbrum I
properties.info: 8,080 m. Karakoram.

properties.name: Broad Peak
properties.info: 8,051 m. Karakoram.

properties.name: Gasherbrum II
properties.info: 8,035 m. Karakoram.

properties.name: Distaghil Sar
properties.info: 7,885 m. Highest peak of the Hispar Muztagh, Karakoram.

properties.name: Masherbrum
properties.info: 7,821 m. Karakoram.

properties.name: Rakaposhi
properties.info: 7,788 m. Near Gilgit and Hunza, Karakoram.

properties.name: Tirich Mir
properties.info: 7,708 m. Highest peak of the Hindu Kush.

properties.name: Indus River
properties.info: Longest river of Pakistan. Flows from Gilgit-Baltistan to the Arabian Sea (simplified path).

properties.name: Jhelum River
properties.info: Flows through AJK and Punjab; joins the Chenab near Trimmu (simplified path).

properties.name: Chenab River
properties.info: Enters Pakistan near Marala; joins the Sutlej at Panjnad (simplified path).

properties.name: Ravi River
properties.info: Flows past Lahore and joins the Chenab (simplified path).

properties.name: Sutlej River
properties.info: Enters Pakistan near Ganda Singh Wala; joins the Chenab at Panjnad (simplified path).

properties.name: Kabul River
properties.info: Enters from Afghanistan; joins the Indus near Attock (simplified path).

properties.name: Badshahi Mosque
properties.info: Lahore, Punjab. Built by Mughal emperor Aurangzeb in 1673; one of the largest mosques in the world.

properties.name: Faisal Mosque
properties.info: Islamabad. Opened in 1986; one of the largest mosques in the world.

properties.name: Wazir Khan Mosque
properties.info: Lahore, Punjab. Built in 1635; famous for its tile work and frescoes.

properties.name: Mahabat Khan Mosque
properties.info: Peshawar, KP. Mughal-era mosque built in the 1600s.

properties.name: Shah Jahan Mosque (Thatta)
properties.info: Thatta, Sindh. Built in 1647; famous for its tile work and acoustics.

properties.name: Masjid Tooba
properties.info: Karachi, Sindh. Known for its single large dome.

properties.name: Mazar-e-Quaid
properties.info: Karachi, Sindh. Mausoleum of Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah, completed in 1970.

properties.name: Tomb of Allama Iqbal
properties.info: Lahore, Punjab. Mausoleum of the national poet, near Badshahi Mosque.

properties.name: Tomb of Jahangir
properties.info: Shahdara, Lahore. Tomb of Mughal emperor Jahangir (17th century).

properties.name: Shah Rukn-e-Alam Tomb
properties.info: Multan, Punjab. 14th-century Sufi shrine, famous for its architecture.

properties.name: Makli Necropolis
properties.info: Thatta, Sindh. One of the largest necropolises in the world; UNESCO World Heritage Site (1981).

properties.name: Data Darbar
properties.info: Lahore, Punjab. Shrine of Sufi saint Ali Hujwiri (Data Ganj Bakhsh).

properties.name: Uch Sharif
properties.info: Near Bahawalpur, Punjab. Historic city with Sufi shrines and tombs.

properties.name: Chaukhandi Tombs
properties.info: Karachi, Sindh. 15th-18th century tombs with carved sandstone.

properties.name: Gaddafi Stadium
properties.info: Lahore. Major cricket stadium; hosted the 1996 World Cup final.

properties.name: National Stadium (Karachi)
properties.info: Karachi. Cricket stadium opened in 1955.

properties.name: Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium
properties.info: Rawalpindi, Punjab. International cricket venue.

properties.name: Multan Cricket Stadium
properties.info: Multan, Punjab. International cricket venue.

properties.name: Margalla Hills National Park
properties.info: Islamabad. Hills and forest park on the edge of the capital.

properties.name: Deosai National Park
properties.info: Gilgit-Baltistan. High plateau at around 4,100 m; home of the Himalayan brown bear.

properties.name: Hingol National Park
properties.info: Balochistan. One of the largest national parks in Pakistan.

properties.name: Khunjerab National Park
properties.info: Gilgit-Baltistan. High-altitude park known for Marco Polo sheep and snow leopard.

properties.name: Ayubia National Park
properties.info: Galyat, KP. Forest park near Murree.

properties.name: Chitral Gol National Park
properties.info: Near Chitral, KP. Known for markhor, Pakistan's national animal.

properties.name: Manora Island
properties.info: Karachi, Sindh. Peninsula at the entrance of Karachi Harbour.

properties.name: Astola Island
properties.info: Balochistan coast. Largest offshore island of Pakistan.

properties.name: Churna Island
properties.info: Near Karachi. Popular for snorkeling and diving.

properties.name: Biafo Glacier

properties.name: Hispar Glacier
properties.info: Karakoram, Gilgit-Baltistan. About 49 km long.

properties.name: Batura Glacier
properties.info: Hunza, Gilgit-Baltistan. About 57 km long.

properties.name: Passu Glacier
properties.info: Hunza, Gilgit-Baltistan. Famous glacier beside the Karakoram Highway.

properties.name: M-1 Motorway
properties.info: Peshawar to Islamabad, about 155 km. Simplified path.

properties.name: M-5 Motorway
properties.info: Multan to Sukkur, about 392 km. Simplified path.

properties.name: M-9 Motorway
